text.L1: Unknown substances should never be tasted or touched to test them.
text.L2: An indicator shows whether a solution is acidic, basic, or neutral by changing colour.
text.L3: Blue litmus turns red in an acid, while red litmus turns blue in a base.
text.L4: Turmeric turns red in a base and stays yellow in acidic and neutral solutions.
text.L5: Hibiscus extract turns dark pink in acids and green in bases.
text.L6: Pure water, sugar solution, and salt solution are neutral, so these indicators show no change.
text.L7: Washing soda turns turmeric red and hibiscus green, so both indicators show that it is basic.
text.L8: Now choose the classification that matches these indicator results.
